title: Nonzero sums of small column sets
statement: Let $k,n$ be positive integers with $k\le n$, and put $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$. In the binary matrix with $(k-1)d+1$ rows and $n$ columns constructed from the enumerated points of the binary field of size $2^d$, the sum of the columns in any nonempty set of at most $k$ columns is a nonzero vector over $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: the column set has cardinality at most $k$
